github-compat.summary: Both round-2 unresolved items are genuinely closed in commit 9c142d2, verified against the tree and by execution, not the claims. (1) T-010 collapse guard: material-change.mjs now compares four headline gauges (publicRepos, totalCommits, totalSourceBytes, contributions.total) against the committed HEAD snapshot BEFORE the change verdict and exits 4 on zero or >50% fall. I proved it in a scratch git sandbox with the real script and the real committed telemetry: quiet week (all clock fields advanced) -> exit 3 skip; owner push -> exit 0; zeroed contribution calendar coinciding with an owner push (the predecessor's exact escape scenario) -> exit 4; 51% totalCommits drop -> exit 4; exactly-50% drop passes, matching T-010's 'more than 50%' wording; ALLOW_METRIC_DROP=1 releases -> exit 0; corrupt JSON -> exit 1, distinct from skip. refresh-telemetry.yml maps exit 4 to ::error + job failure, wires the allow_metric_drop dispatch input (falsy -> '0' on scheduled runs), and its comments no longer overclaim (structural floor attributed to snapshot.ts, collapse catch to the material-change step). Ledgered as STATUS.md deviation 17 and documented in docs/maintenance.md's new collapse-guard paragraph. (2) Refresh commit template: now 'chore(telemetry): refresh measured data ${MEASURED} [skip ci]' with MEASURED read from capturedAt, and docs/tokens.md is rebuilt (npm run docs:tokens) and staged in the commit; deviation 17 records the template. All four round-1 confirmed majors therefore stand resolved (skip logic proven, collapse guard proven, CI README+tokens drift gates present, SHA-pinned actions + concurrency groups + dated [skip ci] template), both overflows remain resolved (topics/descriptions per cross-repo.md and T-008; Active work section present with two bullets + private-work sentence), and the addendum's two minor notes check out (degenerate bullet now capitalised 'Last push 2026-08.'; cross-repo.md correction quote updated to the current no-deployment-target description as a dated second revision). Full gate suite green from the repo root: tsc clean, 62/62 tests, validate 0 errors (327.7 KB, within the 400 KB brief budget), render --check 18/18, and a live npm run qa:github pass (GitHub's real renderer preserved all 8 picture blocks, 10 sources, every asset reference, alt and heading; all 10 external links answer). Regression sweep of 9c142d2 (workflow rewrite, guard, geometry promotions, README/copy edits): all 18 regenerated SVGs remain free of <text>/font-family/scripts/external refs/foreignObject/<image>; README keeps 8 picture blocks with width=890 and resolving srcs; workflow branching logic is sound (set +e capture, exit-3 path restores telemetry.json, unknown codes fail). Non-blocking residue, unchanged from the predecessor and all rooted in round-1 minors: docs still lack a pinned-SHA review cadence note and the graph-inflation disclosure (largely moot - refresh commits are conditional and bot-authored), and recentPushes descriptions are interpolated into Markdown unescaped (owner-controlled, low risk). None of these is a confirmed-major residue; no new critical/major regressions found.

code-architecture.summary: All four round-1 confirmed findings and all five minors are genuinely resolved in the current tree, verified in code and output rather than by claim. The critical hero-stagger bug is fixed with complete per-class animation shorthands (src/hero/hero.ts:301-303); the emitted SVG retains the 900/960/1020ms delays through SVGO's rule merging, and the freshly recaptured timeline frames (empty frame at t=0.3s, mid-stagger readouts at t=1s) prove the choreography now runs as specified. snapshot.ts paginates with a cursor loop, throws on nodes.length !== totalCount, and enforces a sanity floor, with the T-010 collapse guard (exit 4) in material-change.mjs ledgered as STATUS.md item 17. The validator now enforces the brief's 90/45/400 KB budgets per asset and in total, and the lexicon list carries all 41 terms. geometry.ts/motion.ts are deleted, every named dead export (RAW_BASE, status, MIN_TYPE_SIZE, tokens leftovers) is gone, docs match the implementation (including the now-real probe:platform command), the drift gate is two-directional with orphan detection, and material-change has distinct 0/3/4/1 exit codes correctly branched in the SHA-pinned, concurrency-guarded workflow. All gates green: tsc clean, 62/62 tests, validate 0 errors (327.7 KB), render --check clean; a fresh dead-export sweep found nothing of substance. Minor-grade unledgered residuals to note: (1) languages(first:10) in snapshot.ts remains unguarded and is now live - jointledger has 12 languages, so 1,456 bytes (JavaScript 843 B, HCL 613 B) drop silently and HCL is absent from the snapshot (19 languages recorded vs 20 real; the README's "15 languages" cell inherits the undercount; no share/MB figure moves at displayed precision); (2) UserPayload.name is still typed non-nullable string against a nullable API field - a cleared display name would fail the weekly rebuild loudly but with an opaque fontkit TypeError instead of the clear snapshot error round 1 recommended; (3) the recommended entrance-ordering test was not added (the ceiling test now sees the in-shorthand delays, but nothing asserts choreography order, so a future move back to standalone animation-delay would again be test-invisible); (4) material-change.mjs has no unit test and reads data/telemetry.json CWD-relative (safe under the workflow's repo-root cwd, and a crash now fails the job). These are residuals of secondary clauses inside otherwise-resolved findings, individually minor; they should be fixed or added to the deviations ledger but do not outweigh the substantive resolution of every confirmed defect. No new critical or major regression was found across the fix-wave diff scope.

security-hygiene.summary: All four round-1 security-hygiene findings are genuinely resolved in the current tree. (1) The audit-mandated font-licence gate now exists in scripts/validate/validate-all.ts lines 130-150 — it errors if assets/fonts holds font binaries without a licence file and if PROVENANCE.md is absent — and runs via npm run validate in CI on every push (exit 1 on error); the four WOFF2 files remain sha256-identical to @fontsource/jetbrains-mono and the OFL text byte-identical. (2) Both workflows now pin actions/checkout and actions/setup-node to full commit SHAs, which I independently resolved against upstream via gh api: they are exactly the commits the v7.0.1 and v7.0.0 tags point to; concurrency groups are declared in both. (3) docs/maintenance.md documents the 60-day scheduled-workflow auto-disable with the re-enable path (also noted in the workflow header). (4) STATUS.md deviation 14 explicitly records the accepted public .ai/ exposure. Regression sweep of the fix wave (commits 32bcf04..HEAD): no secrets, keys, tokens, or private emails introduced (diff-level scan; only the sanctioned public contact and the owner's public noreply address appear); least-privilege workflow permissions maintained; the refresh token is scoped to the snapshot step with a documented PROFILE_READ_TOKEN fallback and is never logged; the allow_metric_drop dispatch input is consumed only in GitHub expression context (no shell-injection surface); the commit-message interpolation uses locally generated capturedAt; material-change.mjs now has distinct exit codes plus a collapse guard so a crash or zeroed API response cannot read as 'no change'; snapshot.ts sanity floors fail loudly before any write. Gates all green: typecheck clean, 62/62 tests, validate 0 errors (18 assets, 327.7 KB), render --check no drift, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities. Non-blocking observations: the font-licence gate has no dedicated unit test (enforced via the CI validate step; logic verified by inspection), and the local visual-QA browser helper launches Chrome with --no-sandbox (developer/QA tooling only, not part of any published output or the scheduled workflow).
